summary: Assess household cash-flow, debt and shock exposure. Build beneficiary risk profiles and response plans in this five-day course.
lede: Financial risk management for social protection beneficiaries identifies household pressures that can weaken the value and safe use of transfers. For case managers, programme risk officers and monitoring specialists, it provides practical methods to profile cash flow, assess benefit adequacy, and identify debt pressure and harmful coping. Participants also map shock-response and referral options and develop a beneficiary risk register and monitoring scorecard, with digital data governance covered at overview level.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who assess beneficiary circumstances, make case-management decisions or monitor household-level risks across social protection programmes.
modules: Beneficiary Risk Register and Action Planning
prerequisites: Working familiarity with social protection programme delivery, beneficiary support or case management is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
